out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink
violations.observation: The handwashing facility located to the left of the high temp dish machine is blocked by a plastic piece of equipment used within the dish washer, preventing access by employees for easy handwashing.
violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use. PIC UNDERSTANDS THAT HAND SINKS CAN NEVER BE BLOCKED AND MUST ALWAYS BE AVAILABLE FOR EMPLOYEES TO WASH HANDS AND PREVENT POTENTIAL CONTAMINATION. PIC REMOVED THE PLASTIC PIECE OF EQUIPMENT FROM THE HAND WASHING SINK.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: raw chicken was being stored next to ready to eat deli sliced ham in the Everest 1DR UPR cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. PIC UNDERSTANDS THAT RAW FOOD CAN NEVERE BE STORED NEXT TO OR ABOVE READY TO EAT FOODS. RAW FOODS MUST ALWAYS BE STORED BELOW READY TO EAT FOODS. PIC HAD EMPLOYEE MOVE THE RAW CHICKEN TO THE BOTTOM SHELF IN THE EVEREST 1DR UPR COOLER.
